Interpretation: Encoding and decoding produced the corresponding production-engine response on this machine. Encoding core mean about 10% coexisted with encode mean about 98.8%; low core load is not absence of video-engine work.

Each trimmed recovery window has one complete production sample at 0% for encode/decode/video, plus known SMI zeros. Observed return readings are retained, but no production recovery mean or P95 is computed.
D3D 3D remained unknown; SMI query errors occurred in idle/recovery and are retained as missing. Parseable CSV is not error-free GPU querying.
The supplied input is synthetic and ran only in an isolated artifacts directory. It is not evidence that the user needs hardware encoding, decoding or a particular purchased GPU.
SMI and production driver paths are not independent physical ground truth. Percentages need not agree, and this recording is not a calibration, cross-hardware or long-term stability result.
The separate old 0.8.10 soak process remained running and may have observed this artificial load. No release/data records were modified.

Method.Inclusion: Whole sample envelope [Sample.Time - Sample.Seconds, Sample.Time + CollectorMilliseconds/1000] inside the trimmed window. Nonpositive/invalid/>15-second durations and SamplingIssue/TimingIssue rows excluded. Active does not filter controlled-load observations.
Method.Weights: Core uses GpuCoverage or Seconds. Engines use ObservedSeconds or Seconds only with valid Load; CoveredSeconds respects Complete and explicit coverage. Empirical P95 is the first sorted value reaching 95% of valid duration. Mixed source sets have separate distributions; no pooled mean/P95.
Method.Missing: Null, N/A, invalid percentages and absent categories stay missing. Complete only describes exposed category sensors. It is not whole-GPU coverage or driver freshness. Single readings retain only observed min/max; mean/P95/median require two readings.
Method.Reference: SMI rows use receipt UTC, not an assumed 500 ms sampling interval. API timestamps remain raw strings. Values are not independent physical ground truth, and receipt count does not prove independent fresh driver measurements.
Method.Scope: Descriptive phase recording only. review-required is data availability, never pass. Phase status, process exit and RecordingCompleted are original facts, not GPU accuracy, purchase suitability, performance equivalence or long-term stability conclusions. Compare the named encode/decode metrics individually and preserve insufficient categories.
Method.Privacy: Summary omits UUID, PCI identity, process arguments and local absolute paths. Original fixed inputs remain local and unchanged; source sensor names and input hashes are preserved.
